{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to numeric: first remove commas, then cast to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Check for internal test orders (revenue = 999999.99)
test_orders = df[df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
print(f'Number of internal test orders: {len(test_orders)}')

# Filter for completed orders and exclude test orders
df_completed = df[(df['status'] == 'completed') & (df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99)]

# Compute total revenue from completed orders
total_revenue = df_completed['revenue_clean'].sum()

total_revenue"}
